results.explanation: At the declared read_item handler entry, the task premise supplies that current_user is an authenticated active superuser and that the existing item has a different owner. The handler retrieves the item at lines 53-55, then applies the authorization control at lines 56-57: denial occurs only when the caller is not a superuser and the owner IDs differ. Because the supplied premise makes current_user.is_superuser true, that denial condition is false, and execution reaches the return at line 58, so the caller can read the item.
